WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO sl_thread_map (lead_email, campaign_id, hs_contact_id, hs_thread_id)
  VALUES (
    '{{ $json.lead_email.replaceAll("'","").replaceAll('"','') }}',
    {{ $json.campaign_id }},
    '{{ $json.hubspot_contact_id }}',
    gen_random_uuid()::text
  )
  ON CONFLICT (lead_email, campaign_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING hs_thread_id, hs_contact_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT hs_thread_id FROM ins),
    (SELECT hs_thread_id FROM sl_thread_map
     WHERE lead_email = '{{ $json.lead_email.replaceAll("'","").replaceAll('"','') }}'
     AND campaign_id = {{ $json.campaign_id }})
  ) AS hs_thread_id,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT hs_contact_id FROM ins),
    (SELECT hs_contact_id FROM sl_thread_map
     WHERE lead_email = '{{ $json.lead_email.replaceAll("'","").replaceAll('"','') }}'
     AND campaign_id = {{ $json.campaign_id }})
  ) AS hs_contact_id,
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ins) AS is_new_thread
